title: chrysothamnus nauseosus subsp. graveolens
intro: Chrysothamnus nauseosus subsp. graveolens, commonly known as Yellow Sage or Upright Sagebrush, is a shrub native to the western regions of North America. It is a medicinal plant used for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties that can aid in wound healing, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of this plant include reducing inflammation, acting as a natural diuretic, and supporting the immune system due to its bioactive constituents, which include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids. The bioactive constituents present in Yellow Sage provide the plant's therapeutic benefits, making it a valuable resource for traditional medicine.
